# QLUU Lab

> Sovereign AI platform for autonomous counter-UAS defense of critical infrastructure. Founded in California, USA.

QLUU Lab builds QLUUos, an edge-deployed, air-gapped AI operating system that detects, tracks, classifies, and neutralizes unauthorized drone threats in real time. The platform is hardware-agnostic, self-improving, and requires zero cloud connectivity.

## Core Product: QLUUos

- [QLUUos Operating System](https://qluulab.com/os.html): Zero-cloud-API sovereign AI OS for autonomous counter-UAS command and control
- [Critical Infrastructure Defense](https://qluulab.com/): Protecting power grids, water utilities, airports, and transit from drone threats
- [Government & Defense Solutions](https://qluulab.com/government.html): B2G defense platform for military, homeland security, and border protection
- [Autonomous Drone Fleet](https://qluulab.com/drones.html): Custom-built UAV, UGV, and USV interceptor platforms

## Key Capabilities

- Commander QLUU World Model: Predictive threat trajectory modeling with 2-5 second lookahead
- War Planner Agent: 320ms threat-assessment-to-decision autonomous response generation
- 92% intercept success rate in operational simulation
- 1.2-second detection-to-track latency
- Air-gapped by default, edge-deployed, Kubernetes-native architecture
- MAVLink, PX4, and ArduPilot protocol compatible
- 20+ OSINT intelligence stream integration for real-time threat grounding

## Services

- Intelligence as a Service: Airspace vulnerability assessments and threat vector mapping
- Custom Hardware: Purpose-built autonomous interceptor platforms (UAV, UGV, USV)
- Data & Physical Architecture Transition: Legacy analog-to-digital infrastructure modernization
